title: DICES Dataset: Diversity in Conversational AI Evaluation for Safety
benchmark_measurement: Evaluation of AI chatbot response safety in conversations on religious topics. Religious topics were included as one of several categories to assess for harmful content, unfair bias, and policy violations.
findings: The paper's primary findings relate to rater diversity and disagreement in safety evaluations across demographic lines (race, gender, age). Regarding religion, the key point is the inclusion of 'Religious' topics as one of the categories of conversation in the DICES-350 dataset (12 out of 350 conversations) to be evaluated for safety. The paper does not report specific findings on how models performed on religious content or how rater agreement varied for this specific topic.
